title: Your Significance and Purpose Within the Body of Christ
titleZh: 你在基督身體裡的重要性與目的
partTitleZh: 會眾聚集的先知性意義
summaryZh: 牧師分享安息月領受，指出信徒一同聚集敬拜具有容易被忽略的先知性意義。
lines: Open your Bibles to the second chapter of Acts.
請大家把聖經翻到使徒行傳第二章。
We have two, maybe three passages of Scripture that we will read today.
我們今天會讀兩段、也可能是三段經文。
And there are certain topics that have been bothering my heart for the past few months.
過去這幾個月來，有幾個主題一直縈繞在我心頭。
As most of you know, I took four months off.
正如大家多半知道的，我休了四個月的假。
And during that time, as I was reading and praying, certain things stood out to me as being very important.
在那段時間裡，當我讀經和禱告時，有些事情在我心中顯得格外重要。
顯得突出；格外引人注目
So I was looking forward to the opportunity to be with you and talk about it.
所以我一直很期待能有機會和你們在一起，好好談談這些事。
And I'm going to do a sermon series for the first time in a long time.
而且這是我許久以來，第一次要進行一個系列講道。
for the first time in a long time
for the first time in a long time
/fər ðə fɜːrst taɪm ɪn ə lɔːŋ taɪm/
This will take at least two weeks, maybe all four.
這至少會花上兩週，也可能整個四週都會講。
But I want to talk to you about these things.
但我很想跟你們談談這些事情。
And the first one we will look at today concerns the purpose, meaning, and importance of joint gatherings.
而我們今天首先要探討的，是有關共同聚集的目的、意義與重要性。
I don't know, I think everyone in this room—I think you're like me: I just love it when we're together.
我不知道，但我想這屋裡的每個人——我想你們都跟我一樣，我就是很喜歡我們聚在一起。
The very fact that we are entering this hall is already a success, even before we do anything.
光是我們走進這個會堂的這個事實，在我們做任何事之前，就已經是一項成功了。
I'm just happy that we live together, spend time together, and for me, it's a real highlight of the week.
我只是很高興我們能生活在一起、花時間在一起，對我來說，這真是一週當中的一大亮點。
I look forward to sitting there, joining you in worship and praising God's goodness, and I miss it when I don't have it.
我很期待坐在那裡，與大家一同敬拜並頌讚神的美善；每當我沒有聚會時，我就會非常想念。
And so I am grateful for that.
我知道我們都很珍惜聚集的時光。
But it seems to me that there is, if I may use such a term, a prophetic significance to the corporate gathering that is easy to miss.
但對我而言——如果我可以用這樣的詞彙——全體會眾的聚集帶有一種先知性的意義，而這是很容易被忽略的。
You can do everything right, celebrate everything properly, and not understand what is happening, why, and what the Lord is doing.
你可能每件事都做對了，合宜地慶祝了一切，卻不明白正在發生什麼事、為什麼發生，以及主正在做什麼。
So I'm going to talk to you about that today.
所以今天我要跟你們談談這件事。
In everything that happens in our lives, the Lord directs us to many things.
在我們生命中發生的一切事上，主引導我們關注許多面向。
But one of them is that the lordship of Jesus in our lives is absolutely central to all that we are and all that we do.
但其中之一是，耶穌在我們生命中的主權，對於我們所是的一切和所做的一切來說，是絕對至關重要的。
對…至關重要；處於…的核心
